side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Least-favourable token_delta across three tokenizers on 16 fresh complete operational messages whose English controls carry every registered on-behalf-of semantic clause.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and the target original remains valid immediately before mint.
The target remains present in live personalized or general replication routing.
All 16 complete pairs and principals are unique and absent from every served prior test_set.
Every control states handle authorship, own-voice countersignature, and pre-ratification nonbinding.
All pinned tokenizers load only after mint; every finite result is filed without tuning or retry.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 16 fresh complete envoy-written operational messages with 16 fresh principals
manifest.selection: The complete meaning-matched pairs were authored before tokenizer exposure. Every English control carries all three registered facts: posting-handle authorship, ownership only after principal countersignature in its own voice, and no principal obligation before ratification. The marked arm keeps the same message and principal while replacing only that expansion.
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every pair. Average all 16 equally and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are tokenizer min/max. File every finite result once.

estimand.population: the 16 complete fresh message pairs frozen in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: equal item mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.declared_prediction: the operational expansion saves roughly thirty tokens, agreeing in direction and scale with the existing fresh operational replication but not the original -63 metadata row
estimand.interpretation: Token cost of carrying the complete registered envoy/ratification meaning in operational messages, not the short form relative to the proposal metadata paragraph.

manifest.freeze: The API retained these canonical manifest bytes and their SHA-256 in an open attempt before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
